mainEntity.name: What types of natural stone are best suited for outdoor patios and walkways in the Los Angeles climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: For outdoor patios and walkways in the Los Angeles climate, durable and heat-resistant natural stones are ideal. Popular choices include travertine, slate, flagstone (often sandstone or quartzite), and granite. Travertine offers a classic, elegant look and remains cooler underfoot than many other stones. Slate provides a non-slip surface and rich, earthy tones. Flagstone is versatile and naturally slip-resistant, while granite is exceptionally hard-wearing and resistant to stains and scratches. All these options withstand Southern California's sun and occasional moisture without significant degradation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Travertine, slate, flagstone, and granite are excellent choices for outdoor patios and walkways in Los Angeles. These stones are durable, heat-resistant, and can withstand the local climate.
